name: Bestgame
detailed_description:
Finding yourself in a strange new world, you need to learn how to survive! 

Bestgame is a unique survival exploration game highly focused on strange and creative ways to progress.

Choose your class:

Brawler-- High focus on melee.  Throw hands or slash swords and beat your enemies to a pulp!   

Discus Thrower-- If you don't want to fight up close, become a Discus Thrower!  Throw your discus to deal lots of damage, but keep in mind where you throw it, since you'll need to pick it back up again!

Witch-- Cast a variety of spells from magic missiles to big giant death lasers.  Use your tome to slap enemies, swabbing a bit of mana from them to use.

Exploit the local resources: 

Chop trees to build your walls, mine mineralite to craft your tools, or soak your slime in a well to throw at your crops, thus watering them.  Many natural elements are highly interactable.  Pour water on an explosive fiery volatite vein to cool it down, and harvest obsidian from it.  Alternatively, craft a bucket and harvest the volatite straight-up!  If none of these appeal, you can just blow it up, harming you and anyone nearby.

Prepare your base for night time: 

On this cruel planet enemies have evolved specifically for sieging unsuspecting homes.  Living battering rams will destroy your walls, allowing other enemies entrance to your home.  Build your defenses and fend off the increasingly stronger nighttime hordes!  

Explore your world: 

Nine unique biomes are all waiting, holding their own riches just for you!  Find villages and interact with quirky characters all over!  When you're ready, delve into the Dungeons!  Each biome has four dungeons, containing the keys to reach the main Boss.  Defeat each biome's boss to unlock blueprints and advance your technology!

short_description: Bestgame is an exploration/survival game, set in a whimsical fantastical world. Fend off increasingly tougher sieges at night as you try to conquer all of the world's most powerful bosses! Build your base, craft your tools, and get creative to survive!
